text: dsh-model-picker-control 是适用于 DSH 网页端的模型选择器控制插件，通过替换 composer 的模型选择插槽并同步 /model 弹窗，让选择列表采用可配置的分组与顺序。用户可以重命名服务商分组和模型、建立跨服务商分区、隐藏暂时不用的模型、设置模型后缀标记，并按目录、名称或手动方式排序；还可将同组模型整理成文件夹，在额度或其他请求失败时依序切换成员。设置保存在插件自己的 DSH 配置项中，文件夹接力状态保存在本机 DSH state 目录，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-model-picker-control customizes DSH's web model picker. Rename, hide, group, and reorder models across providers, then add colored labels. Folders can switch models after a request fails. Settings use DSH configuration; folder state is stored locally.
我想把不同服务商的模型放进同一个分组里选择。
能不能给模型改个更容易辨认的显示名称？
我想隐藏暂时不使用的模型或整个服务商。
让模型列表按我自己的顺序排列。
我希望给模型名称加上颜色或简短标签。
一个模型额度用完后，能自动换到同组的下一个模型吗？
DSH 的模型选择菜单和 /model 弹窗能显示相同的自定义分组吗？
Can I group models from different providers together in my picker?
I want to rename models and hide entries I no longer use.
How can I make the model list follow my preferred order?
Can a model folder switch to another model when a request hits a quota or provider failure?
dsh-model-picker-control 的功能「跨服务商分区」：把多个服务商的模型归到同一个展示分区，并在模型选择器中作为统一分组呈现。
dsh-model-picker-control 的功能「名称、隐藏与标签」：可分别自定义服务商组名和模型显示名，隐藏单个模型或整个服务商，并添加不同颜色的后缀胶囊。
dsh-model-picker-control 的功能「分组和模型排序」：可拖动调整分区顺序，并按目录顺序、模型名称或手动顺序排列每组模型。
dsh-model-picker-control 的功能「模型文件夹接力」：把同一分组中的多个模型组成文件夹；请求失败时根据失败类型暂时停用当前成员，切换到下一个可用模型并重试。
dsh-model-picker-control 的功能「选择器和弹窗同步」：composer 模型选择插槽与 /model 弹窗使用相同的整理后模型分组；选择仍交给 DSH 的模型目录处理。
dsh-model-picker-control 使用前须知：模型文件夹的会话绑定和冷却状态会写入本机的 DSH state 目录；该目录由 DSH_HOME 决定，未设置时使用 ~/.dsh/state。

English | 中文

Model picker control for DSH — rename, regroup, sort, hide and badge every model in one place.

cross-provider partitions · rename models & groups · drag-to-reorder · hide a provider or a single model · suffix capsules · model folders with quota failover · one-click restore
dsh-model-picker-control README · Introduction：

dsh-model-picker-control README · Why：DSH ships a good model picker, but the display is fixed: providers come in a hard-coded order, model names are whatever the catalog says, and there is no way to put two models from different providers side by side. If you route some models through an account provider and others through a partner provider, the list you actually want never exists.

dsh-model-picker-control README · Why：This plugin gives you one settings page — sitting next to the built-in **Models** page — that owns the *display* of the picker, without patching a single third-party plugin. Hide the models you never touch, rename the rest into something you can recognise at a glance, drag the groups into the order you think in, and merge models from different providers into a partition such as **Free** or **Experimental**.

dsh-model-picker-control README · Features：| | |
|---|---|
| **Rename anything** | Model display names, provider group names, and a short suffix capsule per model. |
| **Cross-provider partitions** | Create a partition and drop models into it from any provider — they render as one group. |
| **Drag to reorder** | Reorder provider groups and partitions with a handle (or focus it and press <kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd>). |
| **Hide, don't delete** | Hide a single model with the eye button; the eye on a provider card hides or shows all of its models at once. Nothing is removed from the catalog. |
| **In-group order** | Catalog order, by model name, or manual (drag in the preview). Per group or globally. |
| **Suffix capsules** | A host-native pill after the name — blue, dark red, cyan, any custom color or a holographic border — that sits beside the host's own `1017` tag. The text may be empty (a color-only chip). Per section, **Capsules** paints every model in it at once, and **Clear empty capsules** removes the text-less ones. |
| **Model folders** | In the preview card, drag a row onto the middle of another row of the same group to merge them into a folder (a "family"). The folder takes

dsh-model-picker-control README · Install：```
dsh plugin add dsh-model-picker-control
```

Then restart DSH. Open **Settings** — a new page, **Model picker** (模型选择器), appears next to the built-in **Models** page.

Prefer a local build?

```bash
git clone https://github.com/qzz19970504/dsh-model-picker-control.git
cd dsh-model-picker-control
npm install
npm test

dsh-model-picker-control README · Quickstart：1. Open **Settings → Model picker**.
2. Under **Groups and partitions**, press **New partition** and name it, for example, `Free`.
3. In the **Models** table, pick `Free` in the partition dropdown of the models you want there — from any provider.
4. Drag the groups into the order you like, hide what you don't use, and give the important ones a suffix capsule such as `NEW` or `cheap`. To color a whole partition at once, use **Capsules** on its row.
5. Optional: in the preview card, drag one model onto the middle of another in the same group to make a folder that fails over from top to bottom.
6. Press **Save**, then open the model picker in the composer. It matches immediately; no restart needed.

dsh-model-picker-control README · Configuration：| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `false` restores the host's own picker but keeps your edits. |
| `sectionOrder` | string[] | Section ids: a provider id, or `p:<partition id>`. |
| `providers[id].name` | string | Group heading. Empty = the catalog name. |
| `providers[id].hidden` | boolean | Hide the whole provider. |
| `models["provider/model"].name` | string | Display name. Empty = the catalog name. |
| `models["provider/model"].suffix` | `{text, tone, color?}` | `tone` is `blue`, `red`, `cyan`, `custom` (needs `color`, `#rrggbb`, default `#ffffff`) or `holo`. Up to 20 characters; `text` may be empty for a color-only chip. |
| `models["provider/model"].partition` | string | `p:<id>` to move it into a partition. |
| `models["provider/model"].hidden` | boolean | Hide this single model. |
| `partitions[]` | `{id, name}` | A partition merges models from different providers. |
| `sort.default` | `catalog` \| `name` \| `manual` | In-group order. |
| `sort.bySection` | map | Per-section override. |
| `order` | map | Per-section list of `provider/model` keys, used by the manual order. |
| `tempHidden` | string[]

dsh-model-picker-control README · How it works：```
composer ──► slot conversation.input.model   (single, session scope)
                 │
                 ├─ host  @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection   priority  0
                 └─ this  dsh-model-picker-control                     priority -1   ← wins, host seat goes inactive

dsh-model-picker-control README · How it works：- The picker seat `conversation.input.model` is a single, session-scoped slot. The plugin registers it at priority `-1`, which shadows the host seat at priority `0`; disabling the plugin brings the host seat straight back. Selecting, reasoning effort, search, keyboard navigation, the pending state and the “not available in subagent sessions” behaviour are all ported from the host picker and use the host's own `model` translations.
- The `/model` popup builds its rows through the same pipeline, so names, groups, order and hidden models match the picker. Row ids stay `provider/model`, so the host's own select handler is still what switches models.
- The model list itself is never modified. The plugin reads `ctx.modelDirectories.directoryFor(sessionId)` and renders a section list derived from the catalog plus your config; choosing a model still goes through `directory.select()`.
- Hiding only changes what is displayed. A saved selection that becomes invisible is left untouched — the trigger falls back to “Select model” and you can pick another one.

dsh-model-picker-control README · FAQ：**Does this patch other plugins?** No. It only registers slots and wraps the host's `/model` contribution in memory, and restores it on dispose.

**I hid the model I was using.** Your saved selection is kept; the trigger shows “Select model” and the picker offers whatever is still visible.

**Where are the settings?** In your DSH profile config, under the plugin's row: `config.picker`. **Restore all defaults** clears them.

dsh-model-picker-control README · FAQ：**Can I keep the `1017` tag and add my own capsule?** Yes, they coexist — the tag and the capsule are separate slots.

**Does it work in subagent sessions?** The picker behaves as the host does there: it is shown as unavailable, matching host behaviour.

npm install
npm run build   # concatenates src/ into lib/client.js (no bundler required)
npm test        # pure pipeline tests (node:test)
npm pack

The source is plain ESM + `h()` calls — `src/pipeline.js` is pure data transformation and is what the tests cover; `src/client/` holds the slot code.
